t: Section 5(d), 7(d), 41(d), and 45(d) of title 3 of the Canal Zone Code, the second sentence of section 42 of such title, and the second sentence of section 82(c) of such title, which provisions require that certain court officials reside in the Canal Zone, are repealed.

fable.w: This section only repeals Canal Zone Code provisions that required certain court officials to reside in the Canal Zone. The mention of court officials might suggest litigation or a right to sue, but nothing here grants any outside party a role in, or a right to challenge, a federal decision. There is no consultation, hearing, comment period, rulemaking, or advisory body involving anyone outside the federal government.
fable.s: which provisions require that certain court officials reside in the Canal Zone, are repealed.
